scope: DWG writer BLOCK_HEADER/BLOCK_RECORD reverse membership for INSERT entities, including XREF and XREF overlay definitions

spec_basis.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
spec_basis.claim: R13-R2000 BLOCK_HEADER records retain first/last entity references; R2000+ also stores a counted sequence of INSERT soft-pointer handles, followed by the layout handle. AC1015 therefore uses both the legacy entity chain and the counted INSERT reverse-reference list.

behavior: Accept bounded, unique, non-null source insertHandles on BLOCK_RECORD definitions.
For source-backed records, compare ordered expected handles to INSERT callbacks actually emitted before finalizing the deferred BLOCK_CONTROL/BLOCK_HEADER records.
Permit INSERT reverse membership on XREF and XREF overlay definitions while continuing to reject owned block content on those definitions.
On mismatch, refuse publication atomically and allow a corrected retry through the same writer facade.

positive_case.readback: BLOCK_RECORD insertHandles and INSERT target/handle/space/owner callback agree

negative_and_retry_case.failure: output refused and existing destination sentinel preserved
negative_and_retry_case.retry: same writer facade accepts corrected 0xA123 membership and readback closes the target reference

generated_controls.legacy_scope: AC1015 now participates in the same generated XREF INSERT membership, mismatch refusal, destination-preservation, same-facade retry, and typed readback matrix. This asserts the counted R2000+ INSERT list coexisting with the legacy first/last entity-chain fields; it does not establish native producer interoperability.

samples.sample: generated reference-loaded XREF output with AC1015 magic
samples.observation: Peer JSON parses the file as AC1015, reports GENERATED_XREF BLOCK_HEADER inserts=[0xA123], and reports INSERT handle 0xA123 targeting BLOCK_HEADER 0x30.
Peer JSON identifies the modelspace INSERT and XREF BLOCK_HEADER; manual peer inspection confirmed the reciprocal INSERT list and target handle.

independent_peer.scope: These are generated interoperability witnesses only, not native source-producer qualification.

validation.result: PASS after extending the matrix to AC1015 (1/1 CTest; generated AC1015-AC1032 profile matrix passes).
validation.fixture_policy: All test drawings are generated in temporary scratch space; no DWG/DXF fixture is added to the repository.

limits: Generated writer/parser consistency across AC1015-AC1032 does not establish native AutoCAD producer behavior or imported-source graph closure.
LibreDWG independently reads one generated AC1015 witness and one generated AC1018 witness; this does not qualify all producer profiles.
This receipt does not promote a DWG/XREF feature support claim.
